22 And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church, 23 Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all. (Ephesians 1:22-23 KJV)

We Christians not only have Christ living in us, but we are His body, the Church. Jesus is not complete without His body the Church. Jesus is the Head, and all us believers are His body, and therefore we make Him complete. When a Christian is born again, he is baptized into the body of Christ (Romans 12:5) and becomes a part of Christ Himself. That is what it means when it says we are in Him, and He is in us. We are one with Jesus, and He is one with us (John 17:11).

Notice that all things are under the feet of Christ. We, being His body, now have all things under us, as if they are under Jesus feet, and we are His body, then they are under all us Christians. That is why we have power over the devil (James 4:7), as Satan has been placed under our feet, and we can rebuke and stomp on him anytime we need to. A Christian should never fear the devil or any demon, but we sure need to be aware that they will try and deceive us every chance they get. Don’t let the devil put thoughts in your mind and deceive you, as that is what he is good at. Just remember that the devil comes only to steal, kill, and destroy you (John 10:10). Praise God for Jesus!
